嗌: ngaai3 - to call out; to order (Cantonese-specific character)
钟: zung1 - to like (as in 钟意)
意: ji3 - meaning; intention (as in 钟意, 好意思)
啲: di1 - some; a bit; plural/possessive-like marker (Cantonese-specific character)
该: goi1 - should; 唔该 = please / thank you
攞: lo2 - to take, to fetch (Cantonese-specific character)
嚟: lai4 - to come (Cantonese-specific character for 来)
睇: tai2 - to look, to watch (Cantonese-specific character)
吓: haa5 - a bit, 'give it a try' (after a verb)
介: gaai3 - to introduce (as in 介绍)
绍: siu6 - to introduce (as in 介绍)
随: ceoi4 - to follow; 随便 = as you like
便: bin2 - convenient (随便 = as you like)
使: sai2 - to need; 唔使 = no need
错: co3 - wrong; 唔错 = not bad
今: gam1 - this (as in 今次 this time)
请: ceng2 - to treat (someone to a meal); to invite
唔该: m4 goi1 - please; thank you; excuse me
随便: ceoi4 bin2 - as you like; whatever
客气: haak3 hei3 - polite; to stand on ceremony
介绍: gaai3 siu6 - to recommend; to introduce
